description: This file declares the SessionManagementServer class, which implements the ISessionManagementServer interface for managing IPC sessions in the Rialto server. It includes class constructors, destructors, and methods for initializing, starting, stopping, and setting log levels, as well as private members for managing IPC server state and client connections.

classes.name: SessionManagementServer
classes.description: Implements the ISessionManagementServer interface to manage IPC sessions, handle client connections, and control server lifecycle.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the IPC server with a socket name and permissions.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the IPC server and begins listening for client connections.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the IPC server and disconnects clients.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the log levels for different components of the server.
